description: Read a domain's registration from its registry's RDAP server: each status with what it means for resolution, the registration, expiry and change dates, the nameservers, whether the delegation is signed. Use it to see whether a domain is expired or on hold, not for what DNS answers (check_domain, dig). Read over HTTPS from the isitdns edge through IANA's RDAP bootstrap, with no key and a limit of 100 calls a minute per address, and no contacts are returned. A hostname is read at the name, then each parent down to two labels, and each HTTP read is listed with its URL, status and time.

domain.description: The domain or a hostname under it. Also as "name"; a URL is read as its host.

name: registration

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

delegationSigned.description: DS at the registry, null if not stated

events.description: Dates by event: registration, expiration, last changed

nameservers.description: The nameservers on file, null if the registry sent none

reads.description: Each HTTP read: url, at, ms, status, error

status.description: Each status, its effect, what it means for resolution

title: Read a registration
